title: Hybrasil Star and Exoplanet Map
dataset_description: The stars, planets, moons and orbits of the star systems within 100 light years of the Sun, with the multiple-star hierarchies, the S-stars round Sgr A* and the solvent chemistry behind the bands. Every value carries its source, and values copied from Wikipedia or inferred rather than measured are marked as such.
tagline: An interactive map of nearby star systems, their stars, planets and moons drawn from published orbits, with the bands round each star where common solvents could be liquid.
